contract: Cancellation does not release the read slot before a non-abortable R2 binding call settles; late metadata is rejected and the queued reader proceeds.
observations: Actual R2 metadata result is held behind a deterministic delivery gate.
Only one binding call occurs before the cancelled first call settles.
Next metadata result has the correct size and remains charged until release.
limitations: Gate delays result delivery after real local binding I/O; it does not emulate native network cancellation.
No production R2 latency or whole-runtime memory proof.
